topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the students, introduces the course structure and diverse student cohort, and outlines the key learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Biological Foundations of Cancer and Differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer originates from accumulated genetic alterations and the failure of normal multicellular differentiation programs, as well as the experimental models used to study tissue architecture.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Tumor Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the clinical and histological features of local tissue invasion and metastatic spread that distinguish benign from malignant neoplasms.

topics.label: Stepwise Tumor Progression and Benign Tumor Behavior
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how benign precursor lesions can progress into invasive adenocarcinomas and explore the clinical risks associated with non-malignant tumors.

topics.label: Tumor Nomenclature and Classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic defines the standard naming conventions and notable exceptions used to classify benign and malignant neoplasms across different tissue lineages.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the local, structural, and systemic mechanisms through which primary and metastatic tumors cause physiological dysfunction and death.

topics.label: Patterns of Cancer Incidence Across Populations and Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine epidemiological cancer incidence and mortality rates in humans and compare tumor susceptibility across diverse animal taxa.

topics.label: Principles and Applications of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the rationale, clinical efficacy, and practical challenges of population screening programs designed to detect pre-cancerous and early-stage tumors.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Preparation
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session by referencing the learning outcomes and providing directions for upcoming revision and practical classes.
